# Copilot Instructions For Netplan Repository

When analyzing a Netplan configuration field data flow from input YAML to rendered backend output (when the user asks to trace a Netplan field), follow:

- `.github/netplan-field-dataflow.md`

For Netdef type details and YAML section-to-type mapping (when the user asks about internal/common representations or nodes), use:

- `.github/netdef-types.md`
